environment: Actual Emery QEMU; no phone JavaScript, real phone or physical watch
directQaAppMessageNote: Python requests native state and sends application receipts; this is not the real phone PKJS/provider transport.

visualReview.method: All48 raw native captures inspected atoriginal200x228 size in two labeled contact sheets; key frames also opened individually.
findings: No clipping or unintended overlaps in changed editor, list, alarm, Ready, paused and running states.
OS app-list countdown visibly ticks after native app exit.
Paused/deleted/same-second rapid pause exit entries have identical cleared native pixels.
Nearby and equal native Wakeups each remain individually acknowledgeable and do not return on reopen.

launcherOrdering: Controlled by PebbleOS. The isolated flash contains Timer and Watchfaces; its first position is not evidence of app-controlled priority pinning.
